<thought>Using the valid functional group names, I will search for retrosynthetic templates that break a carboxylic ester, a C‑C double bond, or an ether oxygen in the target molecule. This should give me plausible disconnections for a route of ≤5 steps.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic esters", "C-C double bonds", "ether oxygens"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
